description: Sleep inducing medicine and anti-inflammatory medicine is found in two pills, pill A and pill B. One pill A contains 3 units of sleep inducing medicine and 5 units of anti-inflammatory medicine. One pill B contains 6 units of sleep-inducing medicine and 1 unit of anti-inflammatory medicine. The cost per pill for pill A is $4 and the cost per pill for pill B is $5. A patient must consume these two pills to get at least 40 units of sleep-inducing medicine and 50 units of anti-inflammatory medicine. Formulate a LP to minimize the cost for the patient.

AmountPerPill.definition: Amount of a medicine type per pill type

RequiredAmount.definition: Required amount of a medicine type

objective.description: "Minimize the total cost of purchasing pill A and pill B while meeting the required amounts of sleep-inducing and anti-inflammatory medicine"

constraints.description: The total amount of sleep-inducing medicine from all pills must be at least 40 units
The total amount of anti-inflammatory medicine from all pills must be at least 50 units
The number of pill A taken must be non-negative
The number of pill B taken must be non-negative

NumPills.definition: Number of pills taken for each pill type
